title: Kula Today
heading: Today
summary: Cloudbase is steady. Kula Ag had mostly sun over the last hour; cloud reaches about 6,900 ft (Puunianiau camera in cloud). Upslope has run since about 07:45 at a light 3 mph, and thermals seem flat. Trades are holding the shear line north of Pukalani, reaching the coast near Haiku, with no trade air on the lower west slope.
